page.notes: Left margin: two references, "1.Pet.4.6." and "Eph.4.9.", are printed and included as notes. Several small stray marks in the left margin (faint dots, a small "c", and a few scratches near the lines of text) are not readable as printed text and are left out. The "1" in "1.Pet.4.6." is read with some doubt. The word "fiam" at the start is doubtful: it may be "etiam" or another word split from the previous page, so it is marked [?]. The italic run "siam, suo spiritu," and the italic line "Tertia die..." are read from the scan. The 'Quod' in "Quodsi" is underlined in print; the underline is kept only as a plain word. The final "vivifi-" is hyphenated as printed; the catchword "cauit" is in the bottom margin.
